feature: ANR Story 1.1 — Readable Tool Call Row

userStories.title: Classify tool calls to families
userStories.description: As a transcript reader, I want every tool call resolved to a stable family, label, headline, and headline kind, so that downstream shells can render one scannable row from provider payloads.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/web/src/lib/tool-presentation.ts exports ToolFamily, ToolPresentationInput, ToolPresentation, and toolPresentation() with no React or @archon/* imports.

FAMILY_ALIASES and input-key resolution follow the exact ordered priorities in the plan: Tier 1 alias, code pair, command key, path key, pattern key, URL key, before/after pair, name-only Codex, then generic.
Normalized tool names match exactly after case-folding and removing underscore and hyphen; search_replace resolves to file, never search.
Glob headlines prefer pattern before path; file/search/web/code families select the first matching string key per plan rules.
Null, arrays, primitives, invalid names, and non-plain-object inputs resolve to generic without throwing.

packages/web/src/lib/tool-presentation.test.ts covers every Tier 1 alias, input-key fallbacks, glob pattern-vs-path headlines, and malformed-input cases; bun test --cwd packages/web src/lib/tool-presentation.test.ts passes.
userStories.technicalNotes: Create packages/web/src/lib/tool-presentation.ts and tool-presentation.test.ts per docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-16-anr-1-1-readable-tool-call-row.md Task 1 (lines 102-297). Use the FAMILY_CASES table and resolver skeleton from the plan. headlineKind is path only for file and glob, text otherwise.

userStories.title: Complete chip, headline, and safe-degradation display
userStories.description: As a transcript reader, I want bounded chips, MCP formatting, shell wrapper stripping, path elision, and safe generic headlines, so that collapsed rows stay readable without raw JSON or unbounded strings.
acceptanceCriteria: tool-presentation.ts exports FAMILY_CHIP_TOKEN mapping families to CSS custom properties per plan and elideHeadline() with path head/tail split and unchanged text arm.
Chip label uses sent name only when it matches /^\S+$/ and length <= 24; otherwise family fallback; chipAriaLabel follows the plan's family-aware pattern.
MCP names parse with /^mcp__(.+?)__(.+)$/; long server · tool labels fall back to generic when over 24 characters.
Codex /bin/zsh -lc and /bin/bash -lc wrappers strip only from first-line headline; multiline names collapse to first line plus ellipsis when more lines follow.
Code family keeps full source headline (not generic scalar limit) and emits language as first payload badge.

Generic family uses at most three scalar key:value pairs (string, finite number, boolean, null only), truncates scalar values at 80 characters, ignores nested objects/arrays, and does not call JSON.stringify or traverse __proto__.
tool-presentation.test.ts passes; bun --filter @archon/web type-check and eslint on tool-presentation files exit zero with no warnings.
userStories.technicalNotes: Extend packages/web/src/lib/tool-presentation.ts per docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-16-anr-1-1-readable-tool-call-row.md Task 2 (lines 300-477). MAX_LABEL_LENGTH=24, MAX_GENERIC_SCALARS=3, MAX_GENERIC_VALUE_LENGTH=80. Depends on US-001 resolver skeleton.

userStories.title: Project shared tool row data and fold interrupted lifecycle
userStories.description: As both Legacy and Console renderers, I want tool history items to carry presentation, exitCode, shared status glyphs, ordered badges, initial expansion, and interrupted folding, so that shells only map render-neutral data to JSX.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentHistoryItem tool arm gains exitCode: number | null and presentation: ToolPresentation; toToolItem() attaches toolPresentation() and resolveExitCode() keeps deriveOutcome() and exit badge consistent.

agent-history.ts exports ToolOutcome, BadgeTone, ToolBadge, ToolRowView, initialToolExpanded(), and toolRowView(); STATUS_GLYPH, OUTCOME_LABEL, and INITIAL_EXPANDED match the plan's five-outcome table (succeeded/failed/running/interrupted/unknown → false/true/false/false/false).
toolRowView() orders badges: payload facts, non-zero exit code, output-state marker (truncated/missing/unknown), then duration; only duration has priority droppable.
A Bash call/result pair with exit_code: 1 projects outcome failed, exitCode 1, shell presentation, and exit 1 sticky error badge in agent-history.test.ts.

Final pass folds a lifecycle item with state === interrupted into the immediately preceding tool item (outcome interrupted, lifecycle row omitted); non-interrupted and orphan interrupted lifecycle rows remain.

NodeRoom.test.tsx toolItem() fixture updated with exitCode: null and structurally complete presentation; bun test --cwd packages/web src/lib/agent-history.test.ts and bun --filter @archon/web type-check pass.
userStories.technicalNotes: Modify packages/web/src/lib/agent-history.ts and agent-history.test.ts per docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-16-anr-1-1-readable-tool-call-row.md Task 3 (lines 481-675). Keep context field until US-006. Import toolPresentation and formatDurationMs. deriveOutcome() at agent-history.ts:120-136 today resolves exitCode internally — surface it via resolveExitCode().

userStories.title: Render Legacy native disclosure row
userStories.description: As a Legacy run-room operator, I want each tool call as one native details/summary row with glyph, chip, headline, and badges, so that I can scan tools without always-open JSON cards.
acceptanceCriteria: NodeRoom.tsx ToolHistory renders each tool as <details data-tool-id> with <summary data-testid="tool-summary">; collapsed summary has no raw JSON punctuation from Input/Output payloads.
useToolDisclosure() hook matches plan: stable initialOpen from initialToolExpanded(), markTouched on summary click, auto-open on failed only when untouched.

Succeeded tools render details without open; failed tools render details open initially; summary shows glyph with role=img and outcome aria-label, chip with FAMILY_CHIP_TOKEN colours, elided path or truncated text headline, and ordered badges.
Legacy glyphColor uses --accent-bright for running; expanded body keeps Input/Output sections and View full output loader (nested details converted to labelled divs).

NodeRoom.test.tsx covers summary content, accessibility (chip aria-label, title=family), and two happy-dom live-transition cases: untouched running→failed opens; manually toggled row stays closed on failure.
NODE_ENV=development bun test --cwd packages/web src/components/workflows/NodeRoom.test.tsx passes; type-check and eslint on NodeRoom files exit zero.
userStories.technicalNotes: Modify packages/web/src/components/workflows/NodeRoom.tsx and NodeRoom.test.tsx per docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-16-anr-1-1-readable-tool-call-row.md Task 4 (lines 679-816). Consume initialToolExpanded, toolRowView, FAMILY_CHIP_TOKEN, elideHeadline from shared lib. Use visibleText() on summary fragment only, not whole static markup. Happy-dom pattern from NodeRoomHeader.test.tsx.

userStories.title: Render Console native disclosure row

acceptanceCriteria: ConsoleAgentHistoryList.tsx mirrors Legacy disclosure markup with Console-specific running token (--running instead of --accent-bright) and duplicates useToolDisclosure locally per AD-12.

Console tests through buildAgentHistory() wire fixtures: succeeded Read pair renders closed details with summary containing checkmark, Read, and a.ts without raw output; failed Bash pair renders open details with cross mark, Bash, bun test, and exit 1.
ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx:1002 updated from open nested card expectation to disclosure contract; two live-transition tests use buildAgentHistory() inputs.
Console imports shared code only from @/lib/agent-history and @/lib/tool-presentation; no Legacy component imports.

NODE_ENV=development bun test --cwd packages/web src/experiments/console/components/ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx passes; bun test --cwd packages/web src/experiments/console/console-isolation.test.ts passes; type-check and eslint on Console files exit zero.
